node.text: Markdown to an interactive A2UI experience

BXP-001 · Search the web and use reliable sources. Find Bengaluru's weather forecast for the next three days. Show the date, high and low temperature in Celsius, and rain probability in a table, followed by two planning tips. Return only the answer in Markdown with source citations. Keep the complete answer within approximately 100-500 tokens; aim for 150-220 words including headings and citations. Avoid a generic introduction and follow-up offers. If requested current data is unavailable, say so briefly.
